title: dev-12: Test fixtures
description: Create .cook fixture files under Packages/CookbookCore/Tests/CookbookCoreTests/Fixtures/. One fixture per test scenario: empty recipe, single ingredient (no quantity), ingredient + timer with quantity, cookware, metadata block, line comment, single-line block comment, multi-line block comment (with a component inside the comment), section header, and one malformed input. Each file is named after its scenario.
acceptance_criteria: At least 10 .cook fixture files exist under Packages/CookbookCore/Tests/CookbookCoreTests/Fixtures/.
Each fixture is a valid UTF-8 text file.
Fixtures cover: empty, ingredient-no-quantity, ingredient-with-quantity, cookware, timer, metadata, line-comment, single-line-block-comment, multi-line-block-comment-with-component, section-header.
Multi-line block comment fixture contains an @ingredient between [- and -] that must NOT appear in the parsed recipe.
